fusions.name: Crushing Embrace
fusions.desc: Wraps both arms around the target and squeezes for 16 damage, stunning it for 1.4 seconds and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Mauling Sweep
fusions.desc: Rakes an open paw through a wide arc 3 tiles deep, dealing 28 damage that ignores armour to everything in it and leaving each target [Weakened] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Come Closer
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 4 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Poked Once Too Often
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (163% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
